metadata.description: Visit every active National Hockey League home arena across the United States and Canada.
metadata.author: Journey

journey.name: NHL Stadiums
journey.description: Visit all 32 active National Hockey League home arenas across the United States and Canada, from historic hockey landmarks to modern downtown venues and the new home of the Utah Mammoth.

items.name: Honda Center
items.description: Home of the Anaheim Ducks, this Southern California arena is known for its steep seating bowl, energetic atmosphere, and prominent location beside Angel Stadium.

items.name: TD Garden
items.description: Home of the Boston Bruins, this downtown arena sits above North Station and carries one of hockey's richest traditions.

items.name: KeyBank Center
items.description: Home of the Buffalo Sabres, this waterfront arena anchors Buffalo's Canalside district and hosts major hockey and entertainment events.

items.name: Scotiabank Saddledome
items.description: Home of the Calgary Flames, this distinctive saddle-shaped arena is one of Canada's most recognizable hockey venues.

items.name: Lenovo Center
items.description: Home of the Carolina Hurricanes, this Raleigh arena is known for passionate tailgating and one of the NHL's most energetic playoff atmospheres.

items.name: United Center
items.description: Home of the Chicago Blackhawks, this large West Side arena honors Chicago sports history with statues, banners, and a famously loud goal horn.

items.name: Ball Arena
items.description: Home of the Colorado Avalanche, this downtown Denver arena sits near the South Platte River and hosts hockey, basketball, concerts, and major events.

items.name: Nationwide Arena
items.description: Home of the Columbus Blue Jackets, this downtown arena anchors the Arena District and celebrates Ohio hockey with a cannon fired after home goals.

items.name: American Airlines Center
items.description: Home of the Dallas Stars, this downtown arena blends brick architecture with a lively sports and entertainment district.

items.name: Little Caesars Arena
items.description: Home of the Detroit Red Wings, this modern downtown arena connects Detroit's historic hockey legacy with the revitalized District Detroit.

items.name: Rogers Place
items.description: Home of the Edmonton Oilers, this downtown arena anchors the ICE District and showcases Edmonton's deep connection to hockey history.

items.name: Amerant Bank Arena
items.description: Home of the Florida Panthers, this Sunrise arena sits beside the Everglades and delivers a distinctive South Florida hockey experience.

items.name: Crypto.com Arena
items.description: Home of the Los Angeles Kings, this downtown arena is a centerpiece of L.A. Live and one of the country's busiest sports and entertainment venues.

items.name: Grand Casino Arena
items.description: Home of the Minnesota Wild, this downtown Saint Paul arena celebrates the State of Hockey and hosts games, concerts, and community events.

items.name: Bell Centre
items.description: Home of the Montreal Canadiens, this downtown arena is one of hockey's most historic and intense environments, surrounded by decades of championship tradition.

items.name: Bridgestone Arena
items.description: Home of the Nashville Predators, this downtown arena sits beside Broadway and blends live-music energy with one of the league's loudest fan bases.

items.name: Prudential Center
items.description: Home of the New Jersey Devils, this downtown Newark arena is known as The Rock and sits near Newark Penn Station.

items.name: UBS Arena
items.description: Home of the New York Islanders, this modern arena at Belmont Park combines premium design with strong connections to Long Island hockey tradition.

items.name: Madison Square Garden
items.description: Home of the New York Rangers, this landmark Manhattan arena sits above Penn Station and is one of the world's most famous sports venues.

items.name: Canadian Tire Centre
items.description: Home of the Ottawa Senators, this arena in Kanata serves Canada's capital region and features a dedicated, bilingual hockey fan base.

items.name: Xfinity Mobile Arena
items.description: Home of the Philadelphia Flyers, this South Philadelphia arena is known for an intense atmosphere and its place within the city's major sports complex.

items.name: PPG Paints Arena
items.description: Home of the Pittsburgh Penguins, this modern downtown arena celebrates the franchise's championship history and Pittsburgh's strong hockey culture.

items.name: SAP Center at San Jose
items.description: Home of the San Jose Sharks, this downtown arena is known as the Shark Tank and features one of the league's most memorable team entrances.

items.name: Climate Pledge Arena
items.description: Home of the Seattle Kraken, this sustainably designed arena preserves the historic roof of the former Seattle Center Coliseum beneath the Space Needle.

items.name: Enterprise Center
items.description: Home of the St. Louis Blues, this downtown arena sits near Union Station and delivers a strong Midwestern hockey atmosphere.

items.name: Benchmark International Arena
items.description: Home of the Tampa Bay Lightning, this waterfront arena is a centerpiece of downtown Tampa's sports and entertainment district.

items.name: Scotiabank Arena
items.description: Home of the Toronto Maple Leafs, this downtown arena stands beside Union Station and represents one of hockey's most prominent stages.

items.name: Delta Center
items.description: Home of the Utah Mammoth, this downtown Salt Lake City arena has been renovated to improve hockey sightlines and create a distinctive new NHL atmosphere.

items.name: Rogers Arena
items.description: Home of the Vancouver Canucks, this downtown arena sits near False Creek and serves as a central gathering place for hockey fans across British Columbia.

items.name: T-Mobile Arena
items.description: Home of the Vegas Golden Knights, this arena near the Las Vegas Strip is known for theatrical pregame shows and a high-energy game presentation.

items.name: Capital One Arena
items.description: Home of the Washington Capitals, this downtown arena anchors the Penn Quarter and Chinatown entertainment district in the nation's capital.

items.name: Canada Life Centre
items.description: Home of the Winnipeg Jets, this intimate downtown arena is renowned for passionate crowds and one of Canada's most intense hockey environments.
